visualCharacteristics: Grid of contributor/people cards. Each card is centered: a circular avatar image on top, the person's name, a role/skills line, and a row of social icon links. Responsive grid, 3-4 across on desktop.
contentPattern: Repeating cards; each card = 2 cells: cell 1 = circular avatar image, cell 2 = name (heading) + role + social links.
usage: Team / contributor / author grids showing people with avatar, name, role, and social links.
